Facing left, KeyE checks (1,7) — nothing. So KeyE always checks the faced tile, never my own tile. The notice board is on my own tile and I can't target it.

Let me step back and reconsider whether I'm truly stuck or if there's a subtlety. The walk_to to (3,7) adjacent said "arrived next to target" — meaning the planner considers (2,7) adjacent to (3,7), which is correct. But it didn't need to move.

Let me try walk_to (3,7) in "stand" mode — that requires actually stepping onto (3,7).
